markdown:
| Sludge Source | (m³/P.E.) |
| --- | --- |
| Waste activated sludge - no primary settling | 0.13 (A) |
| Primary plus waste activated sludge | 0.11 (A) |
| Waste activated sludge excluding primary sludge | 0.06 (A) |
| Extended aeration activated sludge | 0.09 |
| Primary & attached growth biological reactor sludge | 0.09 |
notes: Printed notes below the table, kept inside the region: 'Note:  (A) These volumes also apply to waste activated sludge from single stage nitrification with less than 24 hours detention time based on design average flow;' and 'P.E.-population equivalent as design flow divided by per capita sewage flow.'
The value column heading is printed only as '(m³/P.E.)' with parentheses around the whole expression; Table 6.12 on page 578 prints the same quantity as 'm³/(P.E.)'. Both kept as printed.
The marker '(A)' is printed against the first three values only; the last two rows print a bare number. Whether that omission is intended is not stated in print.
The last source name prints '&' rather than 'and', unlike the 'plus' wording of the rows above. Kept as printed.
Note line ends with a semicolon and the P.E. definition follows as a separate paragraph; both are printed that way.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of the full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNG plus a 300 dpi crop of the table, its caption and both printed note lines; earlier sew-t08 draft re-read and retained. No OCR, no paid service, no delegation.
transcription.observations: First reading only (recovery batch). Caption, both headers, all five rows and both note lines checked glyph by glyph against the image. The last two rows print a bare value with no (A) marker; the heading is printed "(m³/P.E.)" here against "m³/(P.E.)" in Table 6.12. Retained as printed. No distinct second visual pass and no verification seal.
